RemySpecialDeliveries_Scrooge/Scrooge_RP.en: Why, she behaved as if I'm some kind of... some kind of... two-bit villain!

RemySpecialDeliveries_Scrooge/Scrooge_RP.en: I don't know. She made a pretty good case.
Maybe if you lowered your prices a little, she wouldn't think you were villainous?

RemySpecialDeliveries_Scrooge/Scrooge_RP.en: Of course I'm not! I'm a respectable businessman! I'm—... *sigh* I suppose I cannae get too mad. The wee lass is just a bit spirited.

RemySpecialDeliveries_Scrooge/Scrooge_RP.en: In fact, she reminds me of my rambunctious grand-nephews.

RemySpecialDeliveries_Scrooge/Scrooge_RP.original_cz: Vlastně mi připomíná mé bujaré prasynovce.

RemySpecialDeliveries_Scrooge/Scrooge_RP.en: I'll have ya know I worked hard for every penny of my gold! There was no villainy involved! Not a—

RemySpecialDeliveries_Scrooge/Scrooge_RP.en: And a vast number of the pennies I make, I invest right back into the Valley! ...*sigh* I suppose I cannae get too mad. The wee lass is just a bit spirited.
RemySpecialDeliveries_Scrooge/Scrooge_RP.cz: A obrovské množství haléřů, které vydělám, investuji zpět do Údolí! ...*povzdech* Asi se nemůžu moc zlobit. Ta holčička je prostě trochu temperamentní.
